verses.text: Paul, servant of Jesus Christ, wey dem call to be apostle, wey dem set apart for God Good News,
wey e promise before through im prophets for di holy Scriptures,
about im Pikin, wey dem born from David family according to di flesh,
wey dem declare as God Pikin with power, according to di Spirit of holiness, by di resurrection from di dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
through whom we receive grace and apostleship, for obedience of faith among all di nations, for im name sake;
among whom una too dem call to belong to Jesus Christ;
to all wey dey Rome, wey God love, wey dem call to be saints: Grace to una and peace from God our Papa and di Lord Jesus Christ.
First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of una, say una faith dey proclaimed through all di world.
Because God na my witness, wey I dey serve with my spirit for di Good News of im Pikin, how I dey mention una always for my prayers without stopping,
dey ask, if by any means now at last e go work out say by God will I go come to una.
Because I long to see una, so that I go give una some spiritual gift, so that una go strong;
wey mean, say I with una go dey comforted inside una, each of us by di other faith, both una own and mine.
Now I no want make una no know, brothers, say plenty times I plan to come to una—and dem stop me until now—so that I go get some fruit among una too, just as among di rest of di Gentiles.
I be debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to di wise and to di foolish.
So, as much as e dey me, I dey eager to preach di Good News to una wey dey Rome too.
Because I no shame for di Good News of Christ, because na God power for salvation to everybody wey believe; to di Jew first, and to di Greek too.
Because for am dem reveal God righteousness from faith to faith. As e dey write, “But di righteous go live by faith.”
Because God wrath dey revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, wey dey suppress di truth for unrighteousness,
because wetin dem fit know about God clear among dem, because God reveal am to dem.

Because di invisible things of am since di creation of di world dey clear to see, as dem perceive dem through di things wey dem make, even im everlasting power and divinity; so that dem no go get excuse.
Because, as dem know God, dem no give am glory as God, or thank am, but dem become useless for dem reasoning, and dem senseless heart dark.
As dem dey claim say dem wise, dem become fools,
and exchange di glory of di God wey no dey decay for di likeness of image of man wey dey decay, and of birds, and four-footed animals, and creeping things.
So God give dem up too for di lusts of dem hearts to uncleanness, so that dem bodies go dey dishonored among demself,
wey exchange di truth of God for lie, and worship and serve di creature pass di Creator, wey dem bless forever. Amen.
For this reason, God give dem up to vile passions. Because dem women change di natural function to wetin dey against nature.

Na so too di men, as dem leave di natural function of di woman, burn for dem lust towards each other, men dey do wetin no suitable with men, and dey receive inside demself di penalty wey dem error deserve.
Just as dem refuse to keep God for dem knowledge, God give dem up to bad mind, to do those things wey no suitable;
as dem full with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, greed, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
backbiters, wey hate God, insolent, proud, boastful, inventors of evil things, wey disobey papa and mama,
without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, no dey forgive, no dey show mercy;
wey, as dem know di ordinance of God, say di people wey dey practice such things deserve death, no only dey do di same, but dey approve di people wey dey practice dem too.
So you no get excuse, O man, whoever you be wey dey judge. Because for wetin you dey judge another, you dey condemn yourself. Because you wey dey judge dey practice di same things.
We know say God judgment dey according to truth against di people wey dey practice such things.
You think this, O man wey dey judge di people wey dey practice such things, and you dey do di same, say you go escape God judgment?
Or you dey despise di riches of im goodness, forbearance, and patience, as you no know say God goodness dey lead you to repentance?
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart, you dey store up wrath for yourself for di day of wrath and revelation of God righteous judgment;
wey “go pay back to everybody according to dem works:”
to di people wey by perseverance for doing good dey seek glory, honor, and life wey no dey decay, life wey no dey end;
but to di people wey dey look for dem own self only, and no obey di truth, but dey obey unrighteousness, wrath and indignation go dey,
oppression and anguish on every soul of man wey dey do evil, to di Jew first, and to di Greek too.
But glory, honor, and peace go to every man wey dey do good, to di Jew first, and to di Greek too.
Because partiality no dey with God.
Because as many as don sin without di law go perish without di law too. As many as don sin under di law go dey judged by di law.
Because no be di people wey hear di law dey righteous before God, but di people wey do di law go dey justified
—because when Gentiles wey no get di law dey do by nature di things of di law, these ones, as dem no get di law, na law to demself,
as dem dey show di work of di law wey dem write for dem hearts, dem conscience dey testify with am, and dem thoughts among demself dey accuse or excuse dem—
for di day when God go judge di secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
But if you carry di name of Jew, and rest on di law, and dey boast for God,
and know im will, and approve di things wey excellent, as dem teach you from di law,
and you dey confident say you be guide of di blind, light to di people wey dey darkness,
corrector of di foolish, teacher of babies, as you get for di law di form of knowledge and of di truth—
so you wey dey teach another, you no dey teach yourself? You wey dey preach say man no suppose steal, you dey steal?
You wey talk say man no suppose commit adultery, you dey commit adultery? You wey hate idols, you dey rob temples?
You wey dey boast for di law, you dey dishonor God by disobeying di law?
Because “di name of God dey blasphemed among di Gentiles because of una,” just as e dey write.
Because circumcision truly dey profit, if you dey do di law; but if you dey break di law, your circumcision don become uncircumcision.
So if di uncircumcision keep di ordinances of di law, im uncircumcision no go count as circumcision?
Di uncircumcision wey dey by nature, if e fulfill di law, e no go judge you, wey with di letter and circumcision dey break di law?
Because no be Jew be di one wey be Jew outwardly, and circumcision no be di one wey dey outside for di flesh;
but di Jew na di one wey be Jew inwardly, and circumcision na of di heart, for di spirit no be for di letter; wey im praise no come from men, but from God.
So wetin advantage di Jew get? Or wetin benefit circumcision get?
Plenty for every way! Mainly, say dem trust dem with God revelations.
Because wetin if some no get faith? Dem lack of faith go cancel God faithfulness?
E no go ever happen! Yes, make God dey found true, but every man liar. As e dey write, “So that you go dey justified for your words, and go win when you come enter judgment.”
But if our unrighteousness show God righteousness, wetin we go talk? God dey unrighteous wey dey punish with wrath? I dey talk as men dey talk.
E no go ever happen! Because den how God go judge di world?
But if di truth of God through my lie increase to im glory, why dem still dey judge me as sinner?
Why no—as dem dey report us slanderously, and as some dey affirm say we dey talk—“Make we do evil, so that good go come?” Dem condemnation just.
Wetin den? We better pass dem? No, no way. Because we don warn before both Jews and Greeks, say dem all dey under sin.
As e dey write, “Nobody righteous; no, not one.
Nobody dey wey understand. Nobody dey wey dey seek God.
Dem all don turn aside. Dem together don become useless. Nobody dey wey dey do good, no, not even one.”
“Dem throat na open tomb. With dem tongues dem don use deceit.” “Poison of vipers dey under dem lips;”
“wey dem mouth full of cursing and bitterness.”
“Dem feet dey quick to shed blood.
Destruction and misery dey for dem ways.
Di way of peace, dem no know.”
“Fear of God no dey before dem eyes.”
Now we know say whatever di law talk, e dey talk am to di people wey dey under di law, so that every mouth go close, and all di world go come under God judgment.
Because by di works of di law, no flesh go dey justified before am. Because through di law na so knowledge of sin come.
But now apart from di law, God righteousness don dey revealed, as di law and di prophets dey testify;
even God righteousness through faith for Jesus Christ to all and on all di people wey believe. Because no distinction dey,
because all don sin, and fall short of God glory;
as dem dey justify dem freely by im grace through di redemption wey dey for Christ Jesus;
wey God send to be atoning sacrifice, through faith for im blood, to show im righteousness through di passing over of earlier sins, as God dey patient;
to show im righteousness for this present time, so that e imself go be just, and di one wey justify di person wey get faith for Jesus.
Wia den di boasting dey? Dem don exclude am. By which law? Of works? No, but by law of faith.
So we maintain say man dey justified by faith apart from di works of di law.
Or God na God of Jews only? No be God of Gentiles too? Yes, of Gentiles too,
if truly God na one, and e go justify di circumcised by faith, and di uncircumcised through faith.
So we dey cancel di law through faith? E no go ever happen! No, we dey establish di law.
So wetin we go talk say Abraham, our forefather, don find according to di flesh?
Because if Abraham dey justified by works, e get something to boast about, but no be towards God.
Because wetin di Scripture talk? “Abraham believe God, and dem count am to am for righteousness.”
Now to di one wey dey work, dem no count di reward as grace, but as something wey dem owe.
But to di one wey no dey work, but believe di one wey dey justify di ungodly, dem count im faith for righteousness.
Even as David too dey pronounce blessing on di man wey God count righteousness to apart from works:
“Blessed be di people wey dem don forgive dem iniquities, wey dem cover dem sins.
Blessed be di man wey di Lord no go charge with sin at all.”
This blessing den dem pronounce am only on di circumcised, or on di uncircumcised too? Because we talk say dem count faith to Abraham for righteousness.
So how dem take count am? When e dey circumcision, or when e dey uncircumcision? No be for circumcision, but for uncircumcision.

E receive di sign of circumcision, seal of di righteousness of di faith wey e get while e dey uncircumcision, so that e go be papa of all di people wey believe, though dem dey uncircumcision, so that dem go count righteousness to dem too.
E be papa of circumcision too to di people wey no only dey of di circumcision, but wey dey waka for di steps of that faith of our papa Abraham, wey e get while e dey uncircumcision.
Because di promise to Abraham or to im seed say e go be heir of di world no come through di law, but through di righteousness of faith.
Because if di people wey dey of di law na heirs, faith don empty, and di promise no get effect.
Because di law dey produce wrath; because wia no law dey, transgression no dey too.

For this reason e dey of faith, so that e go dey according to grace, so that di promise go sure to all di seed, no be to di one wey dey of di law only, but to di one wey dey of di faith of Abraham, wey be papa of us all.
As e dey write, “I don make you papa of many nations.” This na for di sight of di one wey e believe: God, wey dey give life to di dead, and dey call di things wey no dey as if dem dey.
Who for hope believe against hope, so that e go become papa of many nations, according to wetin dem talk, “Na so your seed go be.”
As e no weak for faith, e no consider im own body, wey don old finish—e be about 100 years old—and di deadness of Sarah womb.
Yet, as e dey look di promise of God, e no waver through unbelief, but e grow strong through faith, dey give God glory,
and dey fully sure say wetin e promise, e fit do am too.
So “dem count am to am for righteousness” too.
Now dem no write say dem count am to am for im sake alone,
but for our sake too, to whom dem go count am, wey believe di one wey raise Jesus our Lord from di dead,
wey dem deliver for our trespasses, and dem raise am for our justification.
So as dem don justify us by faith, we get peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
through whom we get our access by faith enter this grace wey we dey stand inside. We rejoice for hope of God glory.
No only this, but we rejoice for our sufferings too, as we know say suffering dey produce perseverance;
and perseverance, character wey dem don prove; and character wey dem don prove, hope:
and hope no dey disappoint us, because dem don pour God love enter our hearts through Holy Spirit wey dem give us.
Because while we still dey weak, for di right time Christ die for di ungodly.
Because hardly anybody go die for righteous man. Yet perhaps for good person somebody fit even dare to die.
But God dey show im own love towards us, say while we still be sinners, Christ die for us.
Much more den, as dem don justify us now by im blood, we go dey saved from God wrath through am.
Because if, while we be enemies, dem reconcile us to God through di death of im Pikin, much more, as dem don reconcile us, we go dey saved by im life.
No only so, but we rejoice for God through our Lord Jesus Christ too, through whom we don receive di reconciliation now.
So as sin enter di world through one man, and death through sin, and so death pass to all men, because all sin.
Because until di law, sin dey for di world; but dem no dey charge sin when no law dey.
Still death rule from Adam until Moses, even over di people wey dem sins no be like Adam transgression, wey be foreshadowing of di one wey go come.
But di free gift no be like di trespass. Because if by di trespass of di one di many die, much more God grace, and di gift by di grace of di one man, Jesus Christ, abound to di many.
Di gift no be like through one wey sin: because di judgment come from one to condemnation, but di free gift come from many trespasses to justification.
Because if, by di trespass of di one, death rule through di one; much more di people wey receive di abundance of grace and of di gift of righteousness go rule for life through di one, Jesus Christ.
So den as through one trespass, all men dem condemn; na so too through one act of righteousness, all men dem justify to life.
Because as through di one man disobedience many become sinners, na so too through di obedience of di one, many go become righteous.
Di law come in besides, so that di trespass go increase; but wia sin increase, grace increase more well well;
so that as sin rule for death, na so grace go rule through righteousness to life wey no dey end through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Wetin den we go talk? We go continue for sin, so that grace go increase?
E no go ever happen! We wey don die to sin, how we go still live inside am?
Or una no know say all of us wey dem baptize into Christ Jesus, dem baptize us into im death?
So dem bury us with am through baptism into death, so that just as dem raise Christ from di dead through di glory of Papa God, na so we go waka for new life too.
Because if we don join with am for di likeness of im death, we go be part of im resurrection too;
as we know this, say our old self dem crucify with am, so that di body of sin go finish, so that we no go dey bondage to sin again.
Because di one wey die don free from sin.
But if we die with Christ, we believe say we go live with am too,
as we know say Christ, as dem don raise am from di dead, no dey die again. Death no get power over am again!
Because di death wey e die, e die to sin one time; but di life wey e dey live, e dey live to God.
So consider yourselves too to be dead to sin, but alive to God for Christ Jesus our Lord.
So no let sin rule for your mortal body, so that una go obey am for im lusts.
No present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as people wey alive from di dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
Because sin no go get power over una, because una no dey under law, but under grace.
Wetin den? We go sin because we no dey under law, but under grace? E no go ever happen!
Una no know say when una present yourselves as servants to obey somebody, una na servants of di one wey una dey obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
But thanks be to God say, though una be bondservants of sin, una become obedient from di heart to that form of teaching wey dem deliver una to.
As dem don free una from sin, una become bondservants of righteousness.

I dey talk for human terms because of di weakness of una flesh; because as una present una members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, na so now present una members as servants to righteousness for holiness.
Because when una be servants of sin, una free from righteousness.
Wetin fruit una get for that time for di things wey una dey shame for now? Because di end of those things na death.
But now, as dem don free una from sin and una don become servants of God, una get una fruit of holiness and di result of life wey no dey end.
Because di wages of sin na death, but di free gift of God na life wey no dey end for Christ Jesus our Lord.
Or una no know, brothers—because I dey talk to men wey know di law—say di law get power over man as long as e dey live?
Because di woman wey get husband, di law tie am to di husband while e dey live, but if di husband die, dem free am from di law of di husband.
So if, while di husband dey live, e join another man, dem go call am adulteress. But if di husband die, e free from di law, so e no be adulteress, though e join another man.
So, my brothers, una die to di law too through di body of Christ, so that una go join another, di one wey dem raise from di dead, so that we go bring forth fruit to God.
Because when we dey for di flesh, di sinful passions wey dey through di law work for our members to bring forth fruit to death.
But now dem don free us from di law, as we don die to that wey hold us; so that we go serve for newness of di spirit, and no be for oldness of di letter.
Wetin den we go talk? Di law na sin? E no go ever happen! But, I no go don know sin, except through di law. Because I no go don know coveting, unless di law don talk, “You no go covet.”
But sin, as e find opportunity through di commandment, produce all kinds of coveting inside me. Because apart from di law, sin dey dead.
I dey alive apart from di law once, but when di commandment come, sin come alive, and I die.
Di commandment, wey be for life, this one I find say na for death;
because sin, as e find opportunity through di commandment, deceive me, and through am kill me.
So di law truly dey holy, and di commandment holy, and righteous, and good.

So wetin dey good become death to me? E no go ever happen! But sin, so that dem go show say na sin, as e dey work death for me through wetin dey good; so that through di commandment sin go become sinful well well.
Because we know say di law dey spiritual, but I dey fleshly, dem sell me enter bondage to sin.
Because I no know wetin I dey do. Because I no dey practice wetin I want do; but wetin I hate, na that I dey do.
But if wetin I no want, na that I dey do, I agree with di law say e good.
So now no be me dey do am again, but sin wey dey live inside me.
Because I know say inside me, wey mean inside my flesh, no good thing dey live. Because desire dey with me, but I no dey find am dey do wetin good.
Because di good wey I want, I no dey do am; but di evil wey I no want, na that I dey practice.
But if wetin I no want, na that I dey do, no be me dey do am again, but sin wey dey live inside me.
So I find di law, say, to me, while I want do good, evil dey near.
Because I delight for God law according to di inward man,
but I see another law for my members, dey fight against di law of my mind, and dey carry me go captivity under di law of sin wey dey for my members.
Wetin wretched man I be! Who go deliver me from di body of this death?
I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So den with di mind, I myself dey serve di law of God, but with di flesh, di law of sin.
So now no condemnation dey for di people wey dey Christ Jesus, wey no dey waka according to di flesh, but according to di Spirit.
Because di law of di Spirit of life for Christ Jesus don free me from di law of sin and of death.
Because wetin di law no fit do, as e weak through di flesh, God do am, as e send im own Pikin for di likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, e condemn sin for di flesh;
so that di ordinance of di law go fulfill inside us, wey no dey waka according to di flesh, but according to di Spirit.
Because di people wey dey live according to di flesh dey set dem minds on di things of di flesh, but di people wey dey live according to di Spirit, di things of di Spirit.
Because di mind of di flesh na death, but di mind of di Spirit na life and peace;
because di mind of di flesh dey hostile towards God, because e no dey subject to God law, and e no fit too.
Di people wey dey for di flesh no fit please God.
But una no dey for di flesh but for di Spirit, if di Spirit of God dey live inside una. But if any man no get di Spirit of Christ, e no be im own.
If Christ dey inside una, di body dead because of sin, but di spirit alive because of righteousness.

But if di Spirit of di one wey raise Jesus from di dead dey live inside una, di one wey raise Christ Jesus from di dead go give life to una mortal bodies too through im Spirit wey dey live inside una.
So den, brothers, we dey debtor, no be to di flesh, to live after di flesh.
Because if una live after di flesh, una must die; but if by di Spirit una put to death di deeds of di body, una go live.
Because as many as di Spirit of God dey lead, na God pikin dem.
Because una no receive spirit of bondage again to fear, but una receive di Spirit of adoption, by whom we dey cry, “Abba! Papa God!”
Di Spirit imself dey testify with our spirit say we be God pikin dem;
and if pikin dem, den heirs: heirs of God, and joint heirs with Christ; if truly we suffer with am, so that we go receive glory with am too.
Because I consider say di sufferings of this present time no worth to compare with di glory wey dem go reveal towards us.
Because di creation dey wait with eager expectation for di God pikin dem to dey revealed.
Because dem subject di creation to vanity, no be by im own will, but because of di one wey subject am, for hope
say di creation imself go dey delivered from di bondage of decay enter di glorious freedom of God pikin dem.
Because we know say all di creation dey groan and dey suffer pain together until now.
No only so, but ourselves too, wey get di first fruits of di Spirit, even we ourselves dey groan inside ourselves, dey wait for adoption, di redemption of our body.
Because dem save us for hope, but hope wey dem see no be hope. Because who dey hope for wetin e see?
But if we hope for wetin we no see, we dey wait for am with patience.
For di same way, di Spirit dey help our weaknesses too, because we no know how to pray as we suppose. But di Spirit imself dey intercede for us with groanings wey no fit dem talk.
Di one wey dey search di hearts know wetin dey di Spirit mind, because e dey intercede for di saints according to God will.
We know say all things dey work together for good for di people wey love God, to di people wey dem call according to im purpose.
Because di ones wey e know before, e plan before too to look like im Pikin image, so that e go be di firstborn among many brothers.
Di ones wey e plan before, na dem e call too. Di ones wey e call, na dem e justify too. Di ones wey e justify, na dem e give glory too.
Wetin den we go talk about these things? If God dey for us, who fit dey against us?
Di one wey no spare im own Pikin, but deliver am up for us all, how e no go freely give us all things with am too?
Who fit bring charge against God chosen ones? Na God dey justify.
Who be di one wey dey condemn? Na Christ Jesus wey die, yes rather, wey dem raise from di dead, wey dey di right hand of God, wey dey intercede for us too.
Who go separate us from Christ love? Oppression, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
Even as e dey write, “For your sake dem dey kill us all day long. Dem count us like sheep for slaughter.”
But for all these things, we pass conquerors through di one wey love us.
Because I dey persuaded say neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things wey dey now, nor things wey dey come, nor powers,
nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing go fit separate us from di love of God, wey dey for Christ Jesus our Lord.
